binding_contract.coordinate_normalization: x is signed 9-bit; y values 160..255 are represented as wrapped negative screen coordinates
binding_contract.graphics_match: active 4bpp OAM width/height plus exact SHA-256 of the contiguous 1D OBJ VRAM tile payload
binding_contract.origin_candidate: for non-affine matches only: observed screen coordinate minus source component-local coordinate; this is an algebraic candidate, not a traced task writer
binding_contract.palette_ranking: minimum count of unequal BGR555 colors between the source 16-color palette and the OAM-selected runtime OBJ bank
